body.title: Check through a trusted route
body.nextStep: Use the official app or a contact route you already know to confirm the request.
body.reason: The actual website address matters. A familiar name within a link does not establish who controls its destination.
body.uncertainty: A matching domain does not authenticate the sender or the requested action.

evidence.title: Host matches the reviewed Singapore Government record
evidence.detail: Actual host: go.gov.sg. Registrable domain: go.gov.sg. The path after the host does not identify a different website owner. This check does not open the link or follow redirects; no final destination or website owner has been verified. Exact host match to a record reviewed 2026-09-26. This does not authenticate the sender, verify a redirect destination or authorise the requested action.

evidence.title: External link check not performed
evidence.detail: This prototype does not send URL paths, queries, fragments or encoded values to a third party because they may contain private information or access tokens. The full link was not reputation-checked.

evidence.title: Check the actual government website address
evidence.detail: Singapore government websites generally use .gov.sg. Government guidance lists exceptions and official short-link hosts. A name appearing earlier in an unrelated hostname is not a match, and a genuine host does not authenticate a separate message or payment request. Source reviewed 2026-09-26; review expires 2026-10-26. This is reference guidance, not proof about this message.
